exposure: mode of conception (in vitro fertilization (IVF) vs. natural pregnancy (NP))
cohort: The study included 6,871 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants born from January 2014 to December 2016, comprising both singletons and multiplets.
finding: VLBW singletons born after IVF had a comparable risk of neonatal outcomes to those born after NP, except for an increased risk of high-stage retinopathy of prematurity in those born earlier than 28 weeks, while VLBW multiplets born after IVF between 28 and 31 weeks had fewer neurologic morbidities.
gest_age: earlier than 28 weeks, between 28 and 31 weeks
